editorial:
Imagine moving back to your hometown and landing a dream job working for the mayor's family. That is exactly what happens to Grace Anderson, but things go south fast. You get to follow her as she realizes that her new bosses are not as perfect as they seem. Once a local murder happens and Grace starts getting creepy messages, the movie turns into a game of cat and mouse. It feels like one of those mystery stories where everyone is lying to you, and you spend most of the time trying to figure out who is actually the bad guy.

The acting is solid, and the twists keep you guessing until the very end. While some parts of the plot feel a bit slow, the tension makes up for it. If you love a good mystery with a lot of secrets, you will really enjoy this one. You should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the details, or you could rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a fan of owning movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great call.
endingExplained: In the end, you find out that the mayor was actually covering up the crime to protect his own image. Grace discovers the truth through the secret messages she was getting. There is a big showdown where the killer tries to silence her, but Grace manages to outsmart them and call the police. The movie wraps up with the mayor being arrested and Grace finally finding peace in her hometown after all the lies are exposed.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves small-town mysteries and twisty thrillers.
